crystal.intro: Crystal is the heart of Lumalia: a living world, shaped by its players, built to last.
crystal.aboutText: No wild resets, no disposable seasons. We build together, over time, with a stable economy and community-driven projects. Whether you're a builder, explorer or trader, you'll find your place.
crystal.feature1: A persistent survival world with a map that grows as you explore
crystal.feature2: A player-driven economy with shops and jobs
crystal.feature3: Regular events organized by the team and the community
crystal.feature4: A protection system for your builds
crystal.feature5: A global chat and per-project discussion channels
crystal.joinText: The server opens very soon. In the meantime, join our Discord to be notified first and help with preparations.

azur.intro: Azur is Lumalia's creative workshop: a limitless space where imagination takes shape.
azur.aboutText: No resources to farm, no constraints: just you, your creativity, and a flat world to transform. Azur is designed for builders, artists and anyone who wants to experiment without pressure.
azur.feature1: A creative world with protected plots and worldedit
azur.feature3: A freebuild space for collaborative projects
azur.joinText: Azur opens at the same time as Crystal. Join our Discord to follow progress and reserve your plot.

green.intro: Green is Lumalia's North American branch, with its own community and its own rhythm.
green.aboutText: Same philosophy as Crystal — long-term survival, stable economy, collective projects — but with events set on the US timezone and a local team. Ideal if you play from North America.
green.feature1: A survival world dedicated to the US timezone
green.feature2: Events organized in the evening EST/PST
green.feature4: The same features as Crystal (economy, protections, projects)
green.feature5: A cross-server bridge with Crystal for shared events
green.joinText: Green opens its doors soon. Sign up on Discord to be notified at launch.
